requirements.text: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
Available to work 40 hours per week in our San Jose, CA office during Summer 2027.
Strong programming experience in C++, C#, or another lower-level programming language, with a willingness to work close to hardware.
Strong interest in at least one of perception, computer vision, sensor fusion, or edge machine learning.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).
